definition_zh: 车辆模型中连接不同刚体、表示弹性与阻尼作用的两级悬挂系统。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

usage_variants.context_label: 监测与数字化 · Digital Railway Infrastructure（2024）

complete_examples.text: ANSYS® [37] has also been used to model the train, using spring-dashpot elements to simulate the flexibility of primary and secondary suspensions, rigid beams to simulate rigid body motions, and mass point elements located at the center of gravity of each body, namely the car body, the bogies, and the wheelsets, to simulate mass and inertial forces.

Additionally, Fig. 6 shows that most of the frequency content is below 15 Hz, demonstrating the primary and secondary suspensions’ ability to filter out high-frequency components from rolling contact.
